mapper.select: SELECT p.POINT_NUM, p.MEMBER_NUM, p.AMOUNT, p.BALANCE_BEFORE, p.BALANCE_AFTER, p.PAYMENT_PRICE, p.POINT_TYPE, p.DESCRIPTION, p.REGDATE FROM POINT p WHERE p.MEMBER_NUM = #{num} ORDER BY p.POINT_NUM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT ( MEMBER_NUM, AMOUNT, BALANCE_BEFORE, BALANCE_AFTER, PAYMENT_PRICE, POINT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{member_num}, #{amount}, #{balance_before}, #{balance_after}, #{payment_price}, #{point_type}, #{description} )
